{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be safe
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the string '999999.99' in the revenue column
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Check if any revenue strings have unexpected characters
print("Any non-numeric revenue strings?", df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9,.]', regex=True).any())

# Also check: are there any revenue strings with commas that are not in the expected format?
# Look at a few examples
print("Sample of revenue strings:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())"}
